name: v2-high-acceleration
review: The three commanded displacements require (1600,0), (0,1600) and (-1600,-1600) steps at 80 steps/mm, returning to zero. With the source-defined 0.05 mm junction deviation, the 90-degree and 135-degree junction formulas give approximately 32.96 and 9.643 mm/s for the requested 9000 and 3000 mm/s^2 accelerations. Continuous acceleration/cruise/deceleration calculations using the commanded accelerations 500, 9000 and 3000 mm/s^2 and the 100 mm/s feed limit give durations 0.34494, 0.20703 and 0.31312 s versus 0.34492, 0.20692 and 0.31237 s recorded, a maximum difference of 0.24%. Two simulator runs produced identical traces. This approximation does not independently verify every discrete pulse or physical-board timing.
